The furious Steed, the Phyph and Drum Invite you ſtill to Triumphs of the War, Till you as glorious ſhall become On Earth as Mars, in Heaven as bright a Star.
The Balmes rich ſwet, the Myrrhs ſweet teares Perfume your breath when you would Paſsion move: And may her heart, that you indeeres, the center be, her Eye the ſphaere of Love!
And may your Language be of force To body winds, and animate the Trees, So full of wonder your diſcourſe, Till all your gueſſes ſhall be Prophecies.
May our three Gods ſo long conjoyne, To raiſe your ſoule, and rarefie your ſenſe, Till you are render'd ſo Divine, 'Twill be no Sin t' implore your Influence.
